name: Vibrant Rose Pleasure Buddy
description:
A rose-shaped stimulator in medical-grade silicone and ABS, finished in rose red or pink. The bud head carries 9 vibration frequencies and 9 rotation frequencies, plus a neutral mode - nineteen loaded settings in total, switchable in sequence.

The unit weighs 147.8 g and measures 105.61 by 58.48 mm - small enough for one-handed control at any of its settings, with the charge contact sealed against water.

  • Material: medical-grade silicone, ABS
  • Colors: rose red, pink
  • Modes: 9 vibration, 9 rotation, 1 neutral
  • Weight: 147.8 g
  • Dimensions: 105.61 x 58.48 mm
  • Battery: 3.7V 320mAh, magnetic USB, 80-minute charge
  • Noise: under 58 dB
  • Waterproof: IPX7

The 3.7V 320mAh battery recharges over magnetic USB in 80 minutes, and the IPX7 rating takes the whole unit under running water. Noise stays under 58 dB across every mode.

Rose red serves the gift register, pink the everyday one - the same motor and mode set in either shell.
short_description: Rose red and pink silicone vibrator with 9 vibration and 9 rotation frequencies, a neutral mode, quiet operation under 58dB, IPX7 waterproofing and magnetic USB charging.
